items.title: John Best interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well when you joined Goodman, Gene Krupa was probably gone by then. [INTERVIEWEE] Maurice, oh no, I can’t — he died. Morey Feld.

ctx.x: Overseas counted more than home. So we were overseas two out of the three years we were out of the country. You got a little more money, sixteen dollars a month or something, for travel time.
Well when you joined Goodman, Gene Krupa was probably gone by then.
Maurice, oh no, I can’t — he died. Morey Feld.
